answer: Ephemeral Role Lottery. Each epoch, agents draw task slots by hashing a fresh public randomness beacon with their identity; only identities not already seeded can enter the pool, and the beacon fires after registration closes, so attackers cannot predict which puppets win. Pre-registered farm identities earn nothing until drawn, and each dormant identity costs an ivory registration deposit plus ongoing beacon-watch upkeep. Attackers must fund many idle accounts through an unpredictable ridge of selection rounds, and missed draws compound as ember-level friction.
